resources.string: Lets a Mac you allow in Bridgey tap, swipe, go Back or Home and type on this phone while you share your screen with it. Bridgey never reads what is on the screen and never uses your clipboard. You can stop it on the phone at any time.

Android asks you to turn on Bridgey control, an accessibility service, before a Mac can tap and type here. It acts only while you share your screen with an allowed Mac, and it never reads what is on the screen.
